Why We Love It

Our roomiest utility tote just got better! Features a laptop compartment, multiple pockets, pen slots, expandable water bottle pocket holder, key hook, trolley sleeve, adjustable shoulder strap, and waterproof lining for easy cleaning.

[Features]

  • 2 exterior pockets, great for your phone and other easy-access items
  • Padded tablet compartment, fits up to a 17-inch laptop
  • 1 interior water bottle pocket, expandable
  • 3 side interior pockets (1 zippered)
  • 2 pen slots
  • Key leash
  • Trolley pass-through sleeve
  • Removable shoulder strap (max length 52 in)
  • Waterproof lining that wipes down easily
  • Made with sturdy Recycled Canvas
  • Vegan Leather Trim
  • Eco-friendly pigment inks

[Design Inspiration]

Hand-drawn, Hand-printed.

[Dimensions]

16” x 12.5” x 5.5” | Adjustable Strap 52"

Strap drop: 11″

[Care Instructions]

Spot-clean gently as needed. Wipe Vegan leather strap with a damp cloth.
